neighbours.label: the noun before 'yet' after a negated perfect ('hasn't received any reviews yet')
fire: This item hasn't received any ratings yet.
That film has not earned any awards yet.
Our shop hasn't had any complaints yet.
This recipe hasn't received any comments yet.
The new bridge has not seen any traffic yet.
This author has no published books yet.
The page hasn't gotten any visitors yet.
This listing has not attracted any offers yet.
quiet: This item has received many ratings.
That film has earned several awards.
Our shop has had a few complaints.
This recipe has received many comments.
The new bridge has seen heavy traffic.
This author has three published books.
The page has gotten many visitors.
This listing has attracted two offers.
